body.x: Safaudwill be participating in MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT in CES 2019EUREKA PARK, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA fromJanuary 8, 2019 to January 11, # 52843) to showcase the tinnitus therapy.Safaud will also present a pure tone audiometry.

Basedon 20 years of clinical experience, Safaud is committed to bringing the latestIT technology to hearing loss, tinnitus, dizziness and sleep. Conventionaltreatment of tinnitus mainly uses white noise and masking using natural sounds.Safaud has developed a treatment that allows the individual to choose theappropriate treatment option by adding a therapeutic stimulus that inducesneuro-modulation of the auditory cortex in a conventional way.

Safaud'sTinnitus Therapy System provides a safe and appropriate volume of therapy tonethat is calibrated according to the individual's hearing condition and allowsthe patient to select the most appropriate treatment method by evaluating thetreatment effect. It is also possible to track and observe treatment resultsthrough cloud DB data using two THI and VAS questionnaires. In addition, it hasthe advantage of being able to wear the treatment device continuously ineveryday life with open type level device.

Participatingin the CES with Changwon Industry Promotion Agency, Safaud will prepare a planto advance into emerging market developing countries and the US and Europe inthe future. The company plans to develop smart healthcare products in the areasof hearing loss, tinnitus, dizziness, and sleep by working with clinicalhospital specialists.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party.
